notes: ADWIN(delta=0.05) drift sweep over per-entity cosine drift magnitude against entity_clusters.centroid_snapshot. Bulk-load pattern (W4): all state pickle/unpickle bracketed around the per-entity loop; no per-entity round-trip during compute. Warm-up of 50 stable iterations precedes the shift to seed ADWIN windows; the shift phase runs 30 more iterations and ADWIN fires on the perturbed cohort. elapsed_ms is the FINAL compute_drift() sweep only (matches bench-hdbscan convention). false_positive_rate = events_on_unperturbed / total_entities.
